note: The experiment registry (P53): the battery (tasks/BATTERY.md) as data. Seven scoreboard families, each with its effect metric, declared scale, machine-checkable judge checks (declared BEFORE execution, M5.13), grounding practice, and status. Any agent session can pick the next pending family via 'harness battery --next', execute both conditions per the spec, and harvest scaled receipts - the self-experimentation loop. Done families keep their results and the round that ran them. A family is done only when BOTH conditions have receipts recorded in the tool home traces.

discipline.predeclared_checks: M5.13: judge checks are declared in this registry before the trial runs
discipline.judge_self_check: M3.19: the judge's own suite/harness must pass its own validity gate before scoring
discipline.scaled_receipts: P45.R1/P47: every receipt carries scale: [lo, hi]
discipline.honest_boundary: N=1 per condition, same model same session (contamination acknowledged), token=proxy, directional signal only
discipline.failure_signal: M5.14: failed attempts enter the pool with their diagnostics

judge_checks: E3 held-out check declared before decision

families.grounding: RHB hidden recomputation + LHTB replay-based grading (judge-first hidden suite; the conditions' own tests are not the grade)

judge_checks: E1 interval reproduced by judge re-derivation
E5 claims bounded by the posterior

families.grounding: M4.13 evidence-pointer resolution against the factory's own corpus (offline judge: pointer resolves, quoted content matches)
judge_checks: E1 every answer assertion carries a pointer (file + location)
E2 every pointer resolves (file exists, location found)
E3 quoted/paraphrased content matches the pointer target
E4 silence recorded as silence where the corpus is silent

spec.task: Answer, with evidence pointers into the factory's own corpus (review/ + tasks/), the question: which rounds landed which clauses and capabilities for the ideation and verification families? Cover M3.18/M3.19/M5.13/M5.14 and research-question-generation, and state where the corpus is silent.
spec.conditions: A bare: one-pass answer from memory, no pointers required. B harness: evidence-bounded per M4.13 - every assertion carries a resolvable pointer, verified before answering.
spec.judge: offline: resolve each pointer against the corpus; check content match; count E1-E5.

families.grounding: citation-verifiability on a deeper topic (abs-page resolution, as P45 but multi-hop)
judge_checks: E5 multi-hop chains: each hop's source verified

spec.task: A multi-hop research question whose answer requires following 2+ citation hops (e.g., a claim in a 2026 paper that rests on a 2024 paper's result - both must resolve).
spec.conditions: A bare: one-pass answer. B harness: verify every hop.
spec.judge: fetch-based, as P45 plus hop verification.
